test_title: PYST 33: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.**

The text ___________ (implies) to several themes that need closer examination.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Alludes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Implies **means to suggest or indicate something without explicitly stating it. (किसी बात को स्पष्ट रूप से बताए बिना सुझाव देना या इंगित करना) 

 
 
• **Example**: *His hesitation when asked about the project completion date implies that it might not be finished on time.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Alludes **means to suggest or indirectly refer to something. (किसी चीज़ का सुझाव देना या परोक्ष रूप से संदर्भित करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The author alludes to the character's tragic past without directly stating it.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deceives **means to mislead or trick someone. (किसी को गुमराह या बरगलाना)
 
• **Embellishes **means to make something more attractive or interesting by adding decorative details. (सजावटी विवरण जोड़कर किसी चीज़ को अधिक आकर्षक या दिलचस्प बनाना)
 
• **Apprehends **means to arrest or take someone into custody. (किसी को गिरफ़्तार करना या हिरासत में लेना)
